title: Sort the stack
source_of_copy: claude/sessions_industry-acumen-master.md, Part 3, practice 6 (slides 44 and 45). Edit there first, then regenerate this file.
made_up_line: The vendor names are real; every property and owner in this session is made up.
finish: That's the stack. Hear the name, place it in a box, ask what it's for.

boxes.name: PMS
boxes.job: Where every reservation lives and the front desk checks guests in

boxes.name: Channel manager
boxes.job: Sends rates and availability to the OTAs so a room isn't sold twice

boxes.name: Booking engine
boxes.job: The "Book now" page on the property's own website

boxes.name: Dynamic pricing
boxes.job: Moves nightly prices up and down with demand

cards.note: Mews' main product is its PMS; it also sells a booking engine.
The PMS Hyatt and IHG have chosen for their hotels. Worth recognising at a resort that came from a brand.
From the campground and holiday-park world, where many glamping stacks start. It also sells channel management.
Known for its channel manager; it also sells a booking engine.
A channel manager aimed at independent properties; it also sells booking software.
Connectivity between larger hotels and the channels they sell through.
Sabre's booking engine, sitting on Sabre's central reservation system.
Amadeus' booking engine for hotels and resorts.
A vacation-rental website with the booking engine built in; it also syncs with the OTAs.
Grew up in short-term rentals.
Same world as Wheelhouse.
A hotel revenue-management system: the bigger-hotel end of this box.

rounds.title: Around the guest and the market

boxes.name: Rate shopping and market intelligence
boxes.job: Watches what nearby properties charge, date by date

boxes.name: CRM
boxes.job: Holds past guests' stays and spend, so you can market to them

boxes.name: Guest messaging
boxes.job: Texts and chats with guests before and during the stay

boxes.name: Upsell
boxes.job: Sells upgrades and extras before and at arrival

cards.note: Formerly OTA Insight, so owners may still use the old name.
Sells rate-intelligence tools for hotels; it also sells distribution tools.
Market data for vacation rentals: what the area's rentals charge and earn.
Guest data and email marketing for hotels.
A hotel CRM.
HGM's own CRM: where the leads and the email list our funnel builds live. The property's hotel CRM is a second list.
A guest communication hub that sells upsells too.
Guest messaging for hotels, with upsells built in.
Now part of Cloudbeds.
Now owned by Plusgrade, still sold as Oaky.
Oracle's hotel upsell product; pairs with OPERA.
Hotel upsells, including guests bidding for an upgrade.

rounds.title: One suite, many jobs
rounds.intro: Now the other way round. Here's a suite. Drag in only the jobs it does.

suites.note: Sold as one suite: PMS, channel manager and booking engine, plus guest messaging since it bought Whistle. So "we're on Cloudbeds" still doesn't tell you what they use it for. Ask.
A channel manager that also sells a booking engine, and a small-property PMS through Little Hotelier.
suites.verify_what: Little Hotelier as SiteMinder's PMS: confirm on siteminder.com before the dry run; if it isn't, drop pms from does and add it to distractors.

suites.note: A PMS with a booking engine. The channel manager and the pricing come from somewhere else.
